schema.description: JSON {v:1,keywords:string,pills:[{field,op:'=',value}]}. Literal AND keywords and equality pills: kind. Element IDs match exactly.
JSON {v:1,keywords:string,pills:[{field,op:'=',value}]}. Literal AND keywords and equality pills: kind, section, status, change (clean, proposed, staged).

JSON {v:1,keywords:string,pills:[{field,op:'=',value}]}. Literal AND keywords and equality pills: airType (SupplyAir, ReturnAir, ExhaustAir), status (priced, unpriced), needsFix (yes, no). Needs a fix means at least one scoped Fix row holds the price.
JSON {v:1,keywords:string,pills:[{field,op:'=',value}]}. Literal keywords and equality pills. Fields: target, provider, state, unread, scope. Scope values: attention, all, archived.
JSON {v:1,keywords:string,pills:[{field,op:'=',value}]}. Literal AND keywords and equality pills: kind (system, run, leg, element). Element IDs match exactly; ancestors provide context.

mode.description: Staged prescribed-flow TOTAL-pressure closure only, not nonlinear circulation or fan operating-point prediction. Unknown flow/laws remain partial. Source strings are declared premises, not manufacturer approval.

flowCfm.description: The exact flow of this sourced TOTAL-loss design point. It is not a curve and is not extrapolated to another flow.

source.description: Inspectable source or staged design assumption identifying pressure basis, measurement planes and flow; retain any caller static-to-total conversion inputs and rationale.

totalLossInWg.description: Dissipative TOTAL pressure loss in in-wg at flowCfm between the source's exact upstream/downstream planes. Not catalog static pressure. If starting with static loss, caller must establish both velocity pressures and convert: totalLoss = staticLoss + PvUp - PvDown. No automatic conversion or invented curve.

inlet.description: Exact exterior inlet port. Null explicitly declares a lossless connection to the stated quiescent reference reservoir (Pv=0), not an unknown port to omit. Source must justify this design assumption; no implicit entrance loss is added.

connectedTo.description: Required exact native peer witness; null asserts this physical port has no peer. It supplies no pressure, loss or flow premise by itself.

outlet.description: Exact exterior outlet port. Null explicitly declares a lossless connection to the stated quiescent reference reservoir (Pv=0), not an unknown port to omit. Source must justify this design assumption; no implicit discharge loss is added.

referenceTotalPressureInWg.description: TOTAL pressure in in-wg at a declared implicit reservoir plane on a null-port side. A quiescent reservoir has static=total and Pv=0. Ignored when both physical ports are supplied; never an invented cabinet pressure or manufacturer ESP.

boundaryTotalPressureInWg.description: TOTAL pressure in in-wg at the external room/outdoor reference plane beyond the terminal on discharge paths or before it on intake paths. The terminal's explicit total loss is charged separately. Still-air static=total is a stated design assumption; duct static with nonzero Pv must not be supplied unchanged.

flowCfm.description: The exact flow of this sourced TOTAL-loss design point. It is not a curve and is not extrapolated to another flow.

source.description: Inspectable source or staged design assumption identifying pressure basis, measurement planes and flow; retain any caller static-to-total conversion inputs and rationale.

totalLossInWg.description: Dissipative TOTAL pressure loss in in-wg at flowCfm between the source's exact upstream/downstream planes. Not catalog static pressure. If starting with static loss, caller must establish both velocity pressures and convert: totalLoss = staticLoss + PvUp - PvDown. No automatic conversion or invented curve.

loss.description: Explicit sourced TOTAL-loss point for this terminal/opening, including justified zero. Null remains unknown: legacy terminalDrops and native catalog/assigned static values are not reinterpreted as total pressure.
